note: Proposed fixes from a full audit of the 141 chains in data/derived/ubada-khudhu-anni.json (meaning group 730), keyed by sanads.id. corrections.reason: Zawa'id report of 'Abd Allah b. Ahmad: the speaker who heard Shayban b. Abi Shayba (Shayban b. Farrukh) is 'Abd Allah, not his father. The dataset made Ahmad the collector and so created a false Ahmad < Shayban link.
corrections.evidence: Musnad Ahmad 22186, hadith-kg hadiths.id 58360: 'حَدَّثَنَا عَبْد اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ'. No 'حدثني أبي' follows, so this is not Ahmad's own isnad.
corrections.author: claude audit agent (unreviewed)

corrections.reason: Ibn Hibban's informant is his Busti shaykh Muhammad b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Junayd (d. 303, record 29676, which the text mention already uses). Record 29727 is Muhammad b. 'Abd Allah b. Ja'far b. al-Junayd al-Razi (t14, d. 347, Damascus/Rayy), who could not have heard Qutayba (d. 240).
corrections.evidence: Sahih Ibn Hibban 4517, hadith-kg hadiths.id 70555: 'أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْجُنَيْدِ بِبُسْتَ ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ'.
corrections.author: claude audit agent (unreviewed)

corrections.reason: Tahwil misassignment. Muhammad b. al-Jahm's route belongs to the first isnad (Ahmad b. Qasim < Qasim b. Asbagh), not to the second one through 'Abd al-Warith b. Sufyan, which carries Ahmad b. Zuhayr and Bakr b. Hammad only.
corrections.evidence: al-Tamhid 1432, hadith-kg hadiths.id 418334: 'حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ قَاسِمٍ ... حَدَّثَنَا قَاسِمُ بْنُ أَصْبَغَ ... حَدَّثَنَا الْحَارِثُ بْنُ أبي أُسَامَةَ ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْجَهْمِ ، قَالا : حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ' then 'ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ ... أَحْمَدُ بْنُ زُهَيْرٍ ، وَبَكْرُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ'. Sibling chain 415224 (al-Harith) already runs through Ahmad b. Qasim.

corrections.reason: Add Ibn 'Asakir (record 46607) as collector, and restore al-Hasan between al-Fadl b. Dalham and Qabisa: al-Fadl (t7) cannot have heard Qabisa (t3, d. 67), and every other copy of this Waki' < al-Fadl isnad has al-Hasan, including Ibn al-Jawzi's quotation through the same Hibat Allah < Ibn al-Mudhhib < al-Qati'i < 'Abd Allah route (chain 421702) and Musnad Ahmad 15592 itself. The al-Hasan insertion rests on these parallels; the Tarikh Dimashq text as stored omits him. hadith-kg stores no author at pos 0 for this book (pos 0 is always the author's informant), so the chain ends one link short and the informant is treated as the collector.
corrections.evidence: Tarikh Dimashq 52057, hadith-kg hadiths.id 627864: 'قَالَ : وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دَلْهَمٍ ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ'. Musnad Ahmad 15592 (hadiths.id 51766): 'حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دَلْهَمٍ ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ'.
